Subject: Executive summary + procurement path: Redwood pilot (short recap & next steps)

Hi Javier — thanks again for the time earlier today. Below is a concise executive-friendly recap for your sponsor and procurement team. Please let me know if you'd like this reformatted as a one-pager for Maria or procurement.

High-level Business outcomes we discussed:
- Target: 3x reduction in per-inference cost for batch enrichment workloads (current CPU-based service).
- Latency: end-to-end 95th pct target of <200ms for interactive features (pilot scope: two critical endpoints).
- Reliability: soft-SLO of 99.5% during business hours; plan for fallbacks to smaller models.

Key pain/risk items called out by your team:
- Data residency: certain datasets must remain in US-east and not be logged to third-party storage.
- Procurement & compliance: need SOC 2 evidence, KMS/HSM integration plan, and a short data flow diagram for legal.
- Governance: avoidance of PII leakage and a plan for prompt/eval reviews.

Procurement path we agree on (high level):
1) Redwood provides SOC 2 summary + answers to the security questionnaire (attached).
2) Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and SOW draft from Redwood for pilot (30 days, scoped endpoints).
3) PO + standard vendor onboarding (payment & contract) — target 3 weeks after SOW sign-off.
4) Pilot kickoff + weekly touchpoints (owner: Acme eng lead) with CS onboarding.

Immediate next steps (owners & timing):
- Sergio: share SOC 2 summary and the MAP/SOW draft (today) — attachment: redwood-pilot-mop-v1.pdf, security-answers-acme-20260510.pdf.
- Lauren: provide a resourcing plan and pilot success metrics template (tomorrow).
- Rishi: prepare a short tech readiness checklist and integration notes for your infra team (EOD Wed).
- Javier: confirm preferred procurement contact and whether Maria (CFO) should be looped now or after MAP review (reply requested).

Escalation / executive asks to call out to Maria (if helpful):
- Expected cost delta vs status quo in month 1 (pilot) and at steady state.
- Any SLAs we can promise during pilot vs full production.
- A single point of contact from procurement to speed vendor onboarding.

Attachments: redwood-pilot-mop-v1.pdf, security-answers-acme-20260510.pdf

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Hi Javier — quick note from CS on mitigation items you raised. We can provide the following for the pilot and for procurement review: 
- SOC 2 Type II executive summary (attached: soc2-summary.pdf).
- Data flow diagram and KMS/HSM integration notes (we will include a short technical appendix in the SOW).
- Audit log export schedule and retention options (configurable per customer request).

We usually recommend the following pilot guardrails to reduce risk:
1) Limit the pilot to non-PII datasets and a read-only integration for week 1.
2) Scoped volume limits with auto-throttle to prevent cost spikes.
3) Weekly executive check-ins (15 min) to assess quality & infra.

I'll add these to the MAP and to the SOW draft. Happy to join the procurement call.

Best,
